title: Companion scoped source selections
description: Drive the shared source panel against an owned two-node fleet proof. SOURCE_PROOF_ROOT and IOS_SIMULATOR or ANDROID_SERIAL select the fixture and device.

settings.intent: Open farm source controls in Settings.

loaded.intent: The source panel reads the isolated gateway.

invalid.intent: A malformed branch cannot publish a pin.

invalid-pin.intent: The invalid branch keeps Pin branch disabled.

invalid-state.intent: Gateway state stays on main after refused input.

branch.intent: Select a pushed experimental source branch.

keyboard.intent: Finish entry and reveal pin controls.

pin.intent: Pin the branch across the farm.

pin-state.intent: The native action publishes the farm pin through the gateway.

pin-capture.intent: Record branch, scope and base with the recipe HUD.
pin-capture.label: Farm branch source pin

unpin.intent: Return this scope explicitly to main.

main-state.intent: The gateway records the explicit main selection.

main-capture.intent: Record main with the recipe HUD.
main-capture.label: Farm source main

fleet.intent: Open node scope through the fleet route.

node-source.intent: The node source panel is mounted in fleet.

node-capture.intent: Record node precedence and scope with the HUD.
node-capture.label: Node source state

run.intent: Open retained inputs through run detail.

run-capture.intent: Record the retained receipt with the HUD.
run-capture.label: Retained run inputs

pin-visible.intent: The native panel shows the published branch and scope before capture.

main-visible.intent: The native panel shows the returned main selection before capture.

pin-capture-hud.intent: Farm pin shows the pushed branch, scope and main base.

main-capture-hud.intent: Farm selection returns explicitly to main.

node-capture-hud.intent: Node source state reports its main override.

run-capture-hud.intent: Retained run inputs stay fixed and refuse new pins.

run-timeline.intent: Open the run timeline that owns the retained source panel.

run-ready.intent: The retained run workspace exposes its Timeline tab.

stale-arm.intent: Delay the prepared native pin while a real competing RPC changes its revision.

stale-pin.intent: Send the branch pin through the real native transport with obsolete captured revisions.

stale-visible.intent: The real gateway stale rejection is visible and releases the pending command.
text_contains: Stale source declaration or pin revision

stale-state.intent: Assert SOURCE_STATE_STALE came from the real gateway response.

stale-refresh.intent: Read current source facts after the definitive rejection.

stale-after-refresh.intent: Refreshing preserves the rejected operation diagnostic.
text_contains: Stale source declaration or pin revision

fresh-edit.intent: The native stale rejection permits branch editing for a new command.

fresh-keyboard.intent: Finish the fresh branch selection before submitting.

fresh-state.intent: The fresh native packet has a new operation ID, current pin revision and a real successful acknowledgement.

partial-arm.intent: Disconnect one owned execution node before the native sync packet reaches the real gateway.

partial-sync.intent: Sync the source through the native transport while one real execution node is unavailable.

partial-visible.intent: The native panel reports partial completion instead of claiming the action applied.

partial-state.intent: The actual sources.sync response contains per-node diagnostics and the matching operation ID.

partial-refresh.intent: Refresh source facts after the owned node has recovered.

partial-after-refresh.intent: The operation alert retains the real disconnected-node diagnostic after recovery and refresh.

partial-capture-hud.intent: Native partial-sync diagnostics survive recovered source facts and manual refresh.

partial-capture.intent: Record retained operation diagnostics after refresh with the recipe HUD.
partial-capture.label: Native partial source sync after refresh

fresh-ready.intent: The stale rejection and current status allow native branch editing again.

fresh-branch.intent: Select the farm branch with a fresh editable native input.

partial-refreshed.intent: The refresh completes against the recovered node before checking retained diagnostics.
